textNodes: OUR SERVICES
Custom Home Remodeling in Portland, Oregon
From kitchens and bathrooms to full home additions and ADUs, we provide professional remodeling services in Portland designed to improve your space and add long-term value.
Kitchen Remodeling
Custom kitchen remodeling in Portland, including cabinetry, countertops, layout improvements, and full renovations built for long-term value.
LEARN MORE →
Bathroom Remodeling
Bathroom remodeling in Portland with custom tile, showers, vanities, and layout upgrades designed for durability and everyday use.
ADU Construction
ADU construction in Portland, Oregon, including detached units and conversions for rental income, guest space, or multigenerational living.
Home Additions
Home additions in Portland designed to expand your living space with seamless design, structural integration, and quality construction.
Basement Finishing
Basement remodeling in Portland, turning unfinished space into functional living areas with custom layouts and quality finishes.
Commercial Remodeling
Commercial remodeling in Portland, including tenant improvements and build-outs designed for durability, efficiency, and long-term performance.

textNodes: CLIENT REVIEWS
What Homeowners Are Saying
We’ve built our business on referrals, repeat clients, and quality remodeling work throughout Portland and surrounding areas.

Cameron and his crew did an extensive, high-end remodel on my kitchen and entry. He was extremely communicative, transparent, and timely throughout the process. The quality of work exceeded our expectations, and the entire experience felt organized from start to finish.
— Zach, SE Portland Kitchen Remodel

Rip City Construction was professional, detail-oriented, and easy to work with. As with any remodeling project, small issues came up along the way, but Cameron handled everything quickly and professionally. We couldn’t be happier with the final result.
— Chris, Peacock ln. Portland Bathroom Remodel

Rip City Construction completed a major remodel for our home including a master bathroom, office, and attic conversion. The craftsmanship and communication throughout the project were excellent and the final work turned out beautiful.
— Matt, SE 54th Portland Home Remodel

textNodes: ABOUT RIP CITY CONSTRUCTION
Portland Remodeling
Built on Quality Craftsmanship.

Rip City Construction is a Portland remodeling contractor specializing in kitchen remodeling, bathroom renovations, ADU construction, home additions, basement finishing, and full residential remodeling throughout Portland and surrounding areas. Since 2012, we’ve built our business on quality workmanship, clear communication, and referrals from satisfied homeowners.
Our goal is to make the remodeling process organized, transparent, and well-managed from start to finish while delivering high-quality results built to last.

textNodes: OUR SERVICES
Custom Home Remodeling in Portland, Oregon
From kitchens and bathrooms to full home additions and ADUs, we provide professional remodeling services in Portland designed to improve your space and add long-term value.
Kitchen Remodeling
Custom kitchen remodeling in Portland, including cabinetry, countertops, layout improvements, and full renovations built for long-term value.
LEARN MORE →
Bathroom Remodeling
Bathroom remodeling in Portland with custom tile, showers, vanities, and layout upgrades designed for durability and everyday use.
ADU Construction
ADU construction in Portland, Oregon, including detached units and conversions for rental income, guest space, or multigenerational living.
Home Additions
Home additions in Portland designed to expand your living space with seamless design, structural integration, and quality construction.
Basement Finishing
Basement remodeling in Portland, turning unfinished space into functional living areas with custom layouts and quality finishes.
Commercial Remodeling
Commercial remodeling in Portland, including tenant improvements and build-outs designed for durability, efficiency, and long-term performance.
